KEINEMOD-SCROLL_PILE.title: Scroll
KEINEMOD-SCROLL_PILE.description:
A unique pile that stores your [gold]Consumed[/gold] cards. Whenever you enter [green]Hakutaku[/green] form, [gold]Recall[/gold] up to [blue]2[/blue] cards from here.

[gold]Recall[/gold]: Move cards from your [gold]Scroll[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold], they cost [blue]1[/blue] less this turn and gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
KEINEMOD-FULL_MOON.title: Full Moon
KEINEMOD-FULL_MOON.description:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] stack whenever your [gold]Time Shift[/gold] reaches [blue]12[/blue].
Once per turn: you can click on this, spending [blue]1[/blue] stack and enter [green]Hakutaku[/green] form this turn.
